model.tokenizer: greedy longest match over merges, else one token per byte (id = byte_base + byte). Merge k has id byte_base + 256 + k. With space_prefix, a non empty text is tokenized as b' ' + text. detokenize concatenates the pieces, bos and eos are empty.
model.logits: context is the token list given to the model (bos first). h = last*131 + before*31 + len(context)*7, where before is 0 for a one token context. logits[i] = ((h*(i+3) + i*i) % 31) / 2, as float32.
